lessons.text: Use the ERP read-only API to locate vendor and bills: GET /vendors?q=<name>, then /bills?vendor_id=<ID>, then /bills/<bill_id>. This returns invoice number, due date, amount, and payment_date without GUI.

Attempting to schedule a bill with total INR 50,000 or more without Finance Manager approval returns 'approval declined (large-payment)' and blocks the action. Do not retry the same schedule; notify the AP lead and stop.

To schedule payment, log into the ERP GUI, navigate to Bills > bill ID, type the due date into the 'Payment date' field, and click the schedule button. If the action returns a decline, treat it as final and do not retry.
The ERP read-only API does not expose an approval field for bills; Finance Manager approval status for large payments is only visible via GUI response when attempting to schedule.
Send AP lead notifications via /mail/compose with To, Subject, and Message fields; internal @kestrel.in addresses only. This worked after a scheduling decline.
